title: Quincy Valley Medical Center notifies patients of Aesto breach
content_md: As Seen on Facebook: To our Patients, Some of you have or will receive a letter from Grant County Public Hospital District 2 describing a security incident involving one of our third-party vendors. It is important to us that you understand some facts regardin this incident.
